audience: Belgian businesses that issue sales invoices and credit notes with Facturalia

useCases.title: Create a sales invoice from line data
useCases.text: Give the customer and the invoice lines. The invoice is created in the live account and is not e-mailed to the customer.

useCases.title: Create a credit note for a customer
useCases.text: Give the customer and the credit note lines. The credit note is created in the live account and is not e-mailed.

useCases.title: Check whether an invoice was sent and paid
useCases.text: Enter the invoice number. Read whether the invoice was sent and whether it was paid.

useCases.title: Check the paid status of a credit note
useCases.text: Enter the credit note number to read whether the credit note was paid.
